releaseNotes:
• Native Windows Shell Auto-Updater: Completely replaced background scripts with native Electron shell.openPath() via Windows Explorer, eliminating all Antivirus/EDR dropper blocks and PowerShell execution policy restrictions.
• In-App Installation Controls: Added prominent 'Cài đặt & Khởi động lại ngay' and 'Mở thư mục' action buttons directly on the Updates interface when 100% download completes.
• LAN Web Download Portal: Instant web landing page at http://192.168.1.12:8080/ for direct browser one-click downloads across LAN clients.
• Tray & Settings Reliability: Seamless settings window focus and display across all tabs.
